alerts.headline: Gale Warning issued November 26 at 12:53PM EST until November 27 at 1:00PM EST by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...East winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 45 kt and seas 7
to 12 feet.

* WHERE...Massachusetts Bay and Ipswich Bay.

* WHEN...Until 1 PM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
alerts.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.

alerts.area: Eastern Essex; Southeast Middlesex; Suffolk; Eastern Norfolk; Eastern Plymouth; Barnstable; Dukes; Nantucket
alerts.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 26 at 12:54PM EST until November 27 at 3:00PM EST by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Up to one foot of inundation above ground level
expected in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways (3.1 to 12.9 feet Mean Lower Low Water).

* WHERE...Eastern Essex MA, Southeast Middlesex MA, Suffolk MA,
Eastern Norfolk MA, Eastern Plymouth MA, Barnstable MA, Dukes
MA and Nantucket MA Counties.

* WHEN...From 8 AM to 3 PM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Shallow pockets of flooding less than one foot deep
affects the lowest lying areas along the coast, including
Morrissey Boulevard in Boston. Most roads remain passable.
Flooding up to one foot deep affects coastal roads on the
North Shore from Salem to Gloucester and Newburyport. Rough
surf will cause flooding on some coastal roads around the time
of high tide due to splashover. Roads remain passable. Low
lying areas and roads near Nantucket Harbor, including Easy
Street, may experience pockets of shallow flooding less than
one foot deep.
alerts.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

alerts.area: Eastern Essex; Suffolk; Eastern Norfolk; Eastern Plymouth; Southern Bristol; Southern Plymouth; Washington; Newport
alerts.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 26 at 9:12AM EST until November 27 at 7:00AM EST by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...East winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Rhode Island and Massachusetts, excluding Cape Cod
and the Islands.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Peak of the wind gusts is expected during the
early evening to Friday pre-dawn hours.
alerts.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.
